blurb: Cinnabar Hills Golf Club is a public golf course designed by John Harbottle III, blending championship-caliber golf with spectacular views. The course maintains the natural slope of the area and protects local wildlife. The club also offers dining at The Grille, event hosting including weddings, and a historical golf museum.
